purpose: Admission and recipient isolation for peer advice on actual accepted GND2/GND3 synthetic replay, not live training or proof that advice is true.
offer: A typed, editorial advice offer exists before the fresh committed turn. Bind exact speaker/recipient/topic/text and source turn hash; no retrospective extraction of facts from natural language.
evidence: Only process-minted proofs from our own accepted GND3 observer replay. Require a matching emitted utterance and completed heard-utterance, exact source/turn/actor epochs/plan windows/text and prior verified co-presence. Planned, baseline, partial, interrupted, other-recipient and externally rehashed JSON are never admission proofs.
namespace: Separate PeerAdviceInbox: heard-from-peer, unverified-advice, not own experience or observed fact. No matrices, earned samples, skills, money, memories or world changes; GND3 eligibleForReward/P2P remain false.

retention.policy: Reads filter expiry and compute decay without writes. Successful admission may prune expired advice; reject when capacity is full rather than evicting live dedup keys. An expired proof cannot be reintroduced. No future or backwards admission time.

retrieval: Filter world and exact recipient before topic/ranking, stable score/time/id ordering and bounded top-K<=8. Returned metadata must retain named speaker, evidence and hearsay label. No instruction execution, model calls or inferred factual knowledge.
acceptance: Actual accepted physics positive with emitted/heard/encounter proof; chunk/resume equivalent identity and contents.
Baseline/planned/partial/pause/cancel/transit or no recipient cannot mint a delivered proof.
Plain JSON/clone/tamper/cross-world/cross-recipient/future/expired replay rejected; original proof immutable.
Duplicate delivery idempotent, expired/near-capacity pressure bounded, no duplicate amplification through eviction.
Read-time decay, recipient/topic filter before ranking, immutable reads and no private tip bleed.
World/personal policy/memory/skill/samples unchanged; no runtime/DB/API importer.
Bounded deterministic offline benchmark and CLI, checksum/explicit output/no overwrite/no external URLs or secrets.
Full unit/type/lint/assets/build; compiled API regressions unchanged. No browser run required for offline-only modules absent from app bundle.
promotion: No automatic runtime P2P or model/policy promotion. H5b needs durable offer provenance and transactional receipt/advice CAS, source authenticity, API guards, privacy review and separate evaluation before rollout. This protocol does not permit treating a hash or viewer ACK as live delivery proof.
